survey_field_reference.guidance: Level 1–4 map to 20/18/16/14 ga doors; select by usage severity and traffic.
Hinge 10ga (1-3/4" door), lock 14ga, closer 14ga minimum; thru-bolt surface hardware if no reinf.
Select by wall: Drywall (A1/A2/A3/A9/A10), Masonry (A5/A6/A7/A11), Base (A4/A8), Mullion/Sill (A12/A13).
Prime must pass: 120h salt spray (ASTM B117), adhesion ≥ 3B (ASTM D3359), humidity 240h (ASTM D4585).
Door H/W ±3/64; frame depth ±1/16; throat ±3/32; flatness 1/16 edge & 1/8 diagonal; opening +1/16 -1/32.
Approx R-values: Honeycomb 2.08; PS 0.7lb 2.39, PS 1.0lb 2.57; Polyurethane 2.77; Steel-stiffened 1.90.
Select 20–180 min as required; note temp-rise if specified, and lite/door labeling rules (per NFPA/SDI).
Use ANSI preps for template hardware; add continuous hinge/pocket pivot/CVR as required; follow templates.
